QuestInfo.name: Black Energy Analysis
QuestInfo.0: You found a strange energy and gave it to #b#p1092007##k. He didn't know what to do with it, but maybe he knows someone who would.
QuestInfo.1: #b#p1092007##k thinks #b#p1096006##k might be able to figure out where the strange energy came from. #b#p1096006##k is usually at Nautilus's harbor.
QuestInfo.2: You gave the strange energy to #b#p1096006##k.

0.0: Yeah...I doubt I can learn anything from this.\r\nYou'd better just take it to #b#p1096006##k. He'll figure it out.\r\n

yes.0: Things like this are right up #b#p1096006#'s#k alley. I could never understand why #b#p1096006##k liked studying so much.
yes.1: Cutter is in Nautilus Harbor. Make sure you give it to him soon.

no.0: You're supposed to help your fellow Pirates, not slack off like some lazy land-lubber!

1.0: Ooh, I feel all...gloomy. Was it something I ate? No, it's that weird thing you're holding! Hello, science!

yes.0: Right, #b#p1092007##k said you were on your way. So, this is the mystery thing? Well, give it here. I didn't get that degree in Mystery Science for nothing! It's random experimenting time!

npc.0: Go see #b#p1096006##k in Nautilus Harbor and give this Strange Energy to him.

item.0: What's up? Yeah, #b#p1092007##k said he sent you down here with some crazy energy something. Where is it? I was really looking forward to a new crazy energy something!
